subject: Quantitative Aptitude (QA)
purpose: Per-topic target quotas for building a question BANK/dataset, not a simulation of a single session's paper. Multiply/scale as needed. Mirrors the structure used for the NEET/JEE quota files so banks can be planned/compared side by side.
question_type_note: CAT QA mixes single-correct MCQ (typically 4 options, occasionally 5) and TITA (type-in-the-answer, no options and no negative marking). Roughly 65-75% of QA questions are MCQ and 25-35% are TITA, with TITA distributed across all topics rather than concentrated in any one.
difficulty_note: Even 'easy' CAT QA questions assume full command of NCERT Class 9-10 fundamentals; difficulty here reflects relative time-pressure difficulty within the CAT distribution, not absolute conceptual difficulty.
